title: Carport for 2 cars + office and bike room (9.95 x 6.0 m)
description: Option 3 for House > Garage (Proposed), the 'design for the final state' idea. One mono-pitch roof over two car bays at the house end and an insulated 3.2 x 3.9 m box at the east end: a bike and storage room toward the road and an office of about 2.9 x 2.3 m with a window to the garden. The box has a timber floor on ground screws, so there is no slab. The roofed area is 59.2 m2 (59.7 m2 over the roof sheet edge): just under the 60 m2 line, so it needs a building notice and design project, not a permit (the detailed plan still applies). The box's east wall is about 2-3 m from the boundary with 0127, so it must be EI60 (fire-rated board) with no window, plus a written agreement with the neighbour. The roof takes about 24 panels (about 10 kWp).
anchored: Stands on ground screws, so there is no tip check.

joints.fasteners: Post-to-beam steel brackets, 2x M12 bolts each, or a slotted post with 2x M12
Rafter tie (hurricane clip) each side of each rafter at both beams
Panel rails on roof hooks into the battens
Joist hangers or 2x 5x100 screws; floor glued and screwed
2x 90 mm ring-shank nails per stud end; corners with 6x120 screws

hardware.item: Ground screw 76x1000 with adjustable post plate
hardware.notes: One per post. Lift the pavers locally, screw in, re-lay. Keep clear of cable zones.

hardware.item: Profiled steel roof sheet with anti-condensation felt, about 59 m2
Gutter along the back (low) edge, with downpipe to a soakaway
Solar panel about 430 W (24 = about 10.3 kWp) + rails, inverter, small-producer connection
Ground screw 76x1000 for the box floor beams
Mineral wool 150 mm (walls, floor, ceiling), about 45 m2
Vapour barrier, wind barrier, interior boards, about 45 m2 each
Fire-rated board EI60 for the east wall, about 10 m2 (both faces per the fire design)
Exterior cladding (horizontal boards) with battens, about 40 m2
